diagram_previews.alt: A regular hexagon with side 69 containing six congruent green leaf shapes, each joining the centre to a vertex, bounded by arcs of radius 69 centred at the vertices.

Regular hexagon with vertices V0, V1, V2 labelled and centre O; six light green leaves join O to the vertices. The leaf from O to V1 is split by the red chord OV1 into a dark green segment (arc centred at V0) and a blue segment (arc centred at V2); dashed radii from V0 and V2 to O and the 60 degree angle at V0 are shown.
